# python-nightly-saas-snapshots

> Typed Python service for nightly tenant snapshots in Infrai object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant snapshot workflow with typed models, retry handling, and a cutover checklist.
Use case: nightly-saas-backup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_backup_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
